maddeler.e:
تحتفلون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِلُونَ (taḥtafilūna) /taħ.ta.fi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# تُحْتَفَلُونَ (tuḥtafalūna) /tuħ.ta.fa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
